baseline_prompt_en: An adult woman with bobbed hair holds an umbrella while waiting at a rainy bus stop. She wears a cream-colored coat. Her hand closes around the umbrella handle in front of her torso and her feet rest on the pavement beneath the shelter edge. The capture camera faces her from the front. The capture camera is at her eye level. Diffuse daylight brings out damp pavement and a few droplets on the umbrella. The frame gives her waiting posture priority over passing street reflections.
